title: ARIS /meta-optimize — Outer-Loop Harness Optimization via Hook-Based Logging
description: ARIS (Auto-Research-In-Sleep) is a Markdown-only skills framework for autonomous ML research. The /meta-optimize skill (added 2026-04-05) is an outer-loop harness optimizer: passively logs skill invocations, tool calls, failures, and parameter overrides via Claude Code hooks. Uses logged data to auto-tune SKILL.md parameters over time — essentially self-improving the agent's own skill definitions without manual intervention. Architecture: hooks capture execution telemetry → /meta-optimize analyzes patterns → proposes SKILL.md diffs → applies approved changes. Relevant to evolution pipeline's own prompt optimization workflow.
redundancy_check: NOVEL — registry has prompt-optimizer subagent (DSPy-based, explicit invocation) and context-librarian (captures learnings from sessions). /meta-optimize is different: continuous passive hook-based telemetry feeding automatic SKILL.md tuning. No existing equivalent for automatic outer-loop skill parameter adjustment.
